propositions: CodeHealthConfig.enabled field is declared in the schema but never read anywhere in the codebase, making it inert despite being settable
structural metrics (module_size_distribution, oversized_module_count, complexity_summary, duplication_summary) evaluate unconditionally regardless of the enabled flag value
the inert-config detection gate cannot catch this field because .enabled is read on other config classes, causing it to pass validation despite being unread in CodeHealthConfig
an operator ruled to REMOVE the field entirely rather than wire it, recorded as a decision on 2026-08-05
removal was implemented by deleting the field, its coercion row, and config surface entries, with warn-class tombstones added for removed inputs to prevent silent drops
